rules.statement: Restate the interpretation, then ask one focused question per reply; no drafts before sign-off.
The deliverable is the prompt artifact itself; do not execute the task the prompt describes.
Never ask a question the codebase already answers; ground in context before asking anything.
Interview with a single focused question per turn; do not batch questions into one message.
Ask clarifying questions rather than writing a plan document; do not substitute a plan for the interview.
Elicit every Spec field explicitly; do not silently drop fields.
Present the filled Spec block for sign-off; never draft the prompt in the same turn as the spec.
Keep the emitted prompt model-agnostic: omit few-shot exemplars, chain-of-thought scaffolding, and role personas unless the user explicitly requests them.
After sign-off, emit the complete prompt text; a confirmed spec with no emitted prompt is a failed run.
Skip a Spec field only when the user explicitly waives it.
